items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I had never met Spike Jones at the time... he got Nat to come out... to record some things

ctx.x: Now Spike Jones had something to do with this. I had never met Spike Jones at the time, but he was doing something -- engineering or something, but he got Nat to come out, Nat and the trio plus myself to record some things for this measured music thing, because he was involved with it in some manner; I don't know how.

But I set up my drums; I had a brand new set of Levi drums, and I set up my drums, and he told Nat -- he said, "No, he shouldn't play drums on this; he shouldn't play drums. Tell him to take brushes and play on his case, you know, on his drum case."
